work.description: The long letter to Philip Felician of Chełm retains all admonitions on Catholic faith, Ruthenian clergy and seminaries, its blessing and full23May1840 closing. The raw frame was extended through the false XVI8369. Scriptural and patristic reference notes8287–8300 are this letter’s own substantive apparatus and remain selected. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF8071–8071; the source closing at LF8378–8380 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum die vigesima tertia maii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
